relations_to.summary: The state holds half of LuxGovSat, the joint venture with SES that operates the military-grade satellites; the company pre-commits a block of its capacity to NATO. Each partner put in EUR 50m, and the company also took a EUR 125m bank loan for the first satellite (launched 31 Jan 2018). A follow-on satellite (GovSat-2) is being financed by the state; the figure is reported as EUR 301m (or USD 350m) over 12 years, which sources do not agree on.
relations_to.note: Equity figure from search summaries, not from the parliamentary text; to be checked against the government's GovSat-2 documents before use. The GovSat-2 figure is deliberately not written as a number because sources disagree.

sources.title: SES: NATO ground surveillance contract awarded to GovSat
